author: S. Hamza Ali
changes: Fixed RLS violation on overheads: current_tenant_id() now reads from JWT app_metadata instead of never-set session variable (migration 0005)
Fixed record_multi_sale scalar error: removed JSON.stringify — was passing text string to JSONB param causing jsonb_array_elements to fail
Renamed tenant from 'sister' to 'rivayat' — updated TENANT_ID env var, migrated all data rows in brands/settings/overheads
Added input validation to recordSale, recordMultiSale, stockIn (quantity > 0, price > 0, valid sizes, non-empty items array)
Wrapped updateSkuPaidStatus in try/catch with consistent { error? } return type
Added console.error logging to deleteSale and deletePurchase before re-throw
Removed dead x-tenant-id custom header from Supabase client (ignored by Supabase; tenant isolation comes from JWT)
Fixed TypeScript type for record_multi_sale p_items: string → Json to match JSONB parameter
Added audit_logs table with RLS — tracks all data mutations with user_id, user_email, action, summary, metadata
Fixed SECURITY DEFINER RPC tenant isolation: added tenant ownership guard inside record_sale_atomic and record_multi_sale
Added Developer Changelog and Recent Activity sections to Settings page

author: S. Hamza Ali
changes: Dashboard KPI cards: replaced 8 cards with 5 core metrics — Inventory Value, Total Revenue, Total Expenses, Total Cost, Net Profit
Dashboard charts: removed Profit by Brand donut; added Revenue by Channel panel with horizontal bars showing USD and % per channel
Terminology: renamed Record Cost → Record Expense and Cost Log → Expense Log in sidebar and page headers (routes and DB tables unchanged)
Moved developer changelog from DB (settings table) to static src/lib/changelog.json — no SQL needed to update it anymore
Confirmed low stock toggle logic (lowStockAlertsEnabled) fully intact after dashboard refactor
Dashboard layout: removed max-w-[960px] container constraint — KPI cards and charts now expand to fill available width next to sidebar
Expenses: added payment_method column (Cash/Zelle, default Cash) to overheads table — migration SQL provided to user
Record Expense form: added Payment Method dropdown (Cash/Zelle, defaults to Cash), shown in summary sidebar, included in insert payload
Expense Log: added Payment Method column with color-coded badges (green=Cash, violet=Zelle), editable inline, included in CSV export

Fixed multi-tenant RLS write violations: removed getTenantId() (process.env.TENANT_ID) from all insert/upsert payloads — tenant_id is now auto-filled by Postgres from the authenticated user's JWT via column DEFAULT (auth.jwt()->'app_metadata'->>'tenant_id') on brands, settings, overheads, audit_logs (migration 0007)

Security audit — migration 0008: added tenant ownership guards to delete_sale_atomic, delete_purchase_atomic, and stock_in_sku RPCs (SECURITY DEFINER functions previously had no tenant check, allowing cross-tenant deletes/updates by anyone with a valid JWT and a target UUID)

stockIn: hoisted all size/quantity/cost validation before any DB writes to prevent partial commits on validation errors; added costPKR > 0 guard (zero cost silently corrupted avg_cost_pkr on all SKUs); image cleanup on DB failure to prevent orphaned storage objects
sell.tsx: clamped direct quantity input to [0, available] — previously bypassed the stepper's Math.min guard, allowing over-sell attempts that reached the DB
inventory.tsx: clamped qty/buffer/cost edit inputs to >= 0; added toast.error for CSV export failures (was silent console.error only)

author: S. Hamza Ali
changes: Denormalized tenant_id onto all tables (collections, articles, skus, purchases, sales) — industry-standard multi-tenant isolation with simple direct RLS policies instead of multi-join chains (migration 0009)
Dropped dead set_tenant_id() SECURITY DEFINER function — removed unnecessary attack surface
Changed current_tenant_id() fallback from 'default' to NULL — fail-closed instead of fail-open for users without JWT tenant claim
Simplified all 5 SECURITY DEFINER RPCs to use direct tenant_id checks instead of 4-table join chains
Added tenant_id indexes on all 5 newly denormalized tables for RLS query performance
Removed 49 unused UI components and 2 dead hooks (-8,300 lines of dead code)
Removed 27 unused npm dependencies (Radix packages, cmdk, embla, vaul, react-hook-form, etc.)
Removed dead exports: updateSKUQuantity, SaleWithDetails, formatDual, pkrToUsd, DualCurrencyDisplay, browser Supabase client
Deduplicated getExchangeRate() via React.cache — was creating 2 Supabase clients per page load (layout + page)
Exchange rate DB write now skipped when value unchanged — previously wrote on every page load
Added size validation to updateSku (was missing, unlike addSku/stockIn)
Added explicit field allowlist to updateArticle — prevents mass assignment of unexpected columns

author: S. Hamza Ali
changes: SANGAT BRANCH: Rebranded from Rivayat Fashion Lounge to Sangat Jewelry & Accessories
Added vendors table with tenant_id RLS, vendor_payments table for accounts payable ledger
Stock-In: replaced Paid to Wajid with Vendor dropdown, removed Commission field, added Amount Repaid with live vendor balance preview
Stock-In: cost preview now shows USD as primary currency with PKR secondary
Accounts Payable module: new /accounts page with vendor summary KPIs, per-vendor expandable cards with inline payment form
Record Expense: added Vendor Payment category with vendor dropdown — auto-records in vendor_payments ledger
Expense categories updated to accounting terms: Exhibition Rent, Logistics/Delivery, Supplies & Packaging, Vendor Payment, Miscellaneous
Unified Excel backup: Download Complete Backup in Settings exports 7-sheet .xlsx (Inventory, Purchases, Sales, Expenses, Brands, Vendors, Vendor Payments)
Cascading delete now clears expenses, vendor payments, and audit logs in addition to inventory data
Added vendor CRUD: addVendor, deleteVendor, recordVendorPayment server actions with audit logging
